diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts due to the exact Saturday 23:59 certificate expiry fact (PF1) being accessible to the lone decision-maker, which dictates the need for a pressure-vessel inspection before Boiler 2 can operate again. Similarly, check C4 passed because the exact Sunday requirement for 1,200 units (PF3) was also accessible, necessitating the commissioning of Boiler 1 as backup steam capacity.

C3.why: The exact Saturday 23:59 certificate expiry changes the restart plan from ordinary maintenance to a required pressure-vessel inspection before Boiler 2 can operate again.

C4.why: The exact Sunday requirement for 1,200 units changes the contingency plan from leaving Boiler 1 idle to commissioning it as backup steam capacity for that production commitment.
